records.rationale: Full original ten-file bio crypto patch reviewed. Native blk-crypto now owns contexts, key-pointer compatibility, multi-limb DUN arithmetic and request keyslots. Keep native clone/cleanup/advance, all merge gates and DM use of bio_alloc_clone; do not restore obsolete bio-crypt-ctx files, bounce code or slot-number-based compatibility. Multi-limb contiguity rejects final carry rather than treating wrap as contiguous. Separate module-source GPL exports and dm-default-key skip propagation remain retained; this is replacement of old implementation, not loss of Android inline encryption.
